blockers.title: Weak signal: the waiting screen can stay forever, with no control, and tells the instructor not to close the app
blockers.evidence: src/backup/session.ts:621-623 awaits rpc('keep_course') with no timeout or abort signal; the 30 s deadline covers only the pending-upload loop, and the Supabase client at src/backup/session.ts:69-80 sets no fetch timeout. src/features/courseChoice/CourseChoiceScreen.tsx:375-401 offers Riapri only in the 'kept' step after SLOW_MS, nothing in 'working'. Measured at 35 s, 95 s and 185 s: main text 'Tieni D2 - 45 | Invio le modifiche e aggiorno il backup online. Non chiudere l'app.', 0 buttons. The same class of hang was already seen in the field: the comment at src/backup/session.ts:299-301 records a request hung on a dead connection (owner check B4-PHONE-UPLOADS).
blockers.reproduction: Throwaway spec nostromo/b.spec.ts 'hang', pixel-7-chrome: two courses, Tieni questo corso, tick, Elimina, with the fake backend never answering rpc/keep_course. Force-closing the app does recover the choice, but the screen forbids exactly that.
blockers.specRef: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md B7 predicate 'never locks a device'; 06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R14 (real recovery actions); brief: 'spinner forever, no way back'

blockers.title: Two courses with the same code can read identically at the irreversible step
blockers.evidence: src/features/courseChoice/courseChoiceText.ts:41-49 separates a repeated code only by students and last change to the minute. Observed: 'Elimina D2 - 45 (1 allievi, oggi, 12:59) e apri D2 - 45 (1 allievi, oggi, 12:59)', with the same text in the heading, the sentence, the checkbox and Salva prima. One course had 6 crews and 84 evaluations and the other had none; the confirmation shows neither count and has no card to compare. The same roster on two phones gives the same student count, so the minute is the only separator left. Secondary: with the same code in different years, the confirmation never shows the year, which is the real difference ('D2 - 45 (1 allievi, oggi, 12:51)' against 'D2 - 45 (1 allievi, 20 ott 2026, 10:05)'). The existing test at tests/e2e/b7-two-courses.spec.ts:469 only covers different student counts.
blockers.reproduction: Throwaway spec nostromo/c2.spec.ts: a twin course with the same code and student count, crews and evaluations added to one, updatedAt equal on all rows, then Tieni questo corso on the first card. Screenshots samecode-confirm.png and samecode-confirm-320-200.png.
blockers.specRef: 06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R11 (deletion with identity and consequence); docs/design/mockups/b7-two-courses.html state 2; comment at courseChoiceText.ts:37-40; brief: must not erase the wrong course

importantFindings.title: Answer lost on the way: the screen says nothing changed after the server has already erased
importantFindings.evidence: Observed with serverCourses=1: 'Non sono riuscito a eliminare C3 - 45 dal backup online. Non è cambiato nulla: i corsi sono ancora qui.' CourseChoiceScreen.tsx:414-418 treats every 'failed' as nothing changed, although the migration's own header (keep_course.sql:11-12) expects lost answers. Torna alla scelta then repeats 'Non è stato cancellato nulla'.
importantFindings.reproduction: nostromo/b.spec.ts 'lost answer': the fake applies keep_course and then aborts the response with connectionreset.

importantFindings.title: After a successful choice and Riapri, the app asks the question again and says nothing was erased
importantFindings.evidence: Step state lives only in memory. After 'La scelta è salva' and Riapri l'app, with the download not yet arrived: 'Scegli il corso da tenere ... Non è stato cancellato nulla', serverCourses=1, both cards offered. Tieni on the erased course then says 'Tieni C3 - 45? D2 - 45 sarà eliminato', naming the course that was kept as the one to go. On the 'gone' path the lead 'Non è stato cancellato nulla' also sits directly above the notice 'Quel corso è già stato eliminato su un altro dispositivo' (CourseChoiceScreen.tsx:469-481), a false source when this device made the choice.
importantFindings.reproduction: nostromo/b.spec.ts 'kept, download slow': keep D2, wait 31 s, Riapri l'app, read, then Tieni on C3. Screenshot kept-reopened.png.
importantFindings.specRef: 06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R14; 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md, Several courses on one account

importantFindings.title: Step changes move neither focus nor scroll: at 200% the confirmation opens below its own question
importantFindings.evidence: At 320×640 and 200%, tapping Tieni on the lower card: scrollY 1374 becomes 829, heading top -689, so the question, the erase sentence and the warning are above the screen; the viewport starts at the end of the provider sentence and shows Salva prima, the checkbox, Elimina and Annulla. Annulla keeps scrollY 829. document.activeElement is BODY after Tieni, Annulla and on the failed screen. The Confirm section has no live role or focus target, so a screen reader is not told it opened; the app shell does focus main on navigation (src/App.tsx:708-710). At 100% (390×664, three courses) and 150% (412×839) the heading stays visible: top 92 and 97.

importantFindings.title: Signed in with a backup error, the screen says to sign in, and the real recovery sits at the bottom

importantFindings.title: A second course arriving reloads the phone mid-typing, past the leave guard
importantFindings.evidence: src/App.tsx:957-963 calls window.location.reload() directly, while updates go through requestLeave so that unsaved screens can ask first (src/navigation/applyUpdate.ts). Observed with 'Scrittura InCorso' typed in the add-student form: loads=1, form gone, the choice screen showing, no warning. Reloading away is reasonable because those screens can no longer save; losing typed work silently is not.
importantFindings.reproduction: nostromo/h.spec.ts 'a second course arrives while the instructor types'. The connected status was stubbed, since the fake backend has no sync stream, and the status listeners were fired by hand.

importantFindings.title: Salva file: less information and fewer ways out than Impostazioni, on the last step before an erase
importantFindings.evidence: Measured: shareOffered=0, privacyWarning=0. The only feedback is 14 px 'Salvataggio avviato.', with no file name or location, set as soon as link.click() returns, so it does not prove a file exists (CourseChoiceScreen.tsx:60-77, 97-110). Two taps saved 2 files with one unchanged status line. After Annulla and re-entering, the status is gone (status count 0), so the confirmation no longer shows the file was saved. CourseFiles.tsx:310-314 warns that the file holds students' personal data, 344-353 confirms the file is ready and explains sharing, and 88-91 scrolls feedback into view. The owner's Android report recorded an export where 'the button needed two taps before anything visible happened' and sharing to WhatsApp as the accepted route off the phone. The approved mock shows no share button, so its absence conforms to the mock; the owner may want it reconsidered.
importantFindings.reproduction: nostromo/e.spec.ts 'salva file feedback and failure'. Real Android behaviour not checked; see notTested.

qolFindings.title: Cards can swap under the thumb on a 3 s refresh (wildcard)

fieldWalkthrough.scene: Pier, 18:00, phone in a splash pouch, 412×839. Two phones made a course each, so the app opens on the choice. Same synthetic data as the tests.
steps: 1. Open the app. Tieni is enabled at 2.7 s on the dev server (sampled once).
2. Read two cards. At 390×844 both fit with no scroll; buttons at y361 and y613, in reach of a thumb, 44 px high. This screen is good.
3. Tap Tieni questo corso on D2. Tap 1.
4. Read 'C3 - 45 sarà eliminato...'. Clear when the codes differ.
5. Optional: tap Salva prima il file. Tap 2. Read 'Salvataggio avviato.' and wonder where the file went: read twice, no answer.
6. Tick Ho capito. Tap 3 (2 without the file). Elimina goes from a pale pink block to solid red.
7. Tap Elimina. Tap 4 (3 without the file). The spinner says not to close the app.
8. Good signal: 'Scelta salvata', then the app reopens by itself on D2 when the download arrives.
9. Bad signal: the spinner stays with no button (FU-B7-1), or 'Non è cambiato nulla' when the erase did happen (FU-B7-I1), or, after Riapri, the same question again (FU-B7-I2).

notTested: A real Android installed PWA: whether the anchor download shows anything to the user, whether the second file prompts, and what 'Salvataggio avviato' corresponds to. This needs the owner's phone; no simulator result stands in for it
TalkBack or VoiceOver output: focus and live roles were read from the DOM and ARIA snapshot only
Real sunlight: contrast was computed, never observed outdoors
A real dead connection: the hang was simulated by an unanswered route, so how long a phone's network stack would hold the request is unknown
A live backend and PowerSync stream: downloads were simulated by editing synced tables, and FU-B7-3 was run against the fake
Real OS text scaling: 200% was simulated with the root font size, as the repository's own tests do
Screen lock or app swap during the working step, and an update tapped during it: not exercised
The iPhone 13 engine beyond the 320/200% layout test
One sample in the flap test returned no article cards 2.5 s after signal returned; it did not recur in two dedicated sampled runs and is not reported as a finding
